Typing Vietnamese

With Telex on, type plain letters and the marks appear.

aa → â · ee → ê · oo → ô
double the vowel
aw → ă · ow → ơ · uw → ư
w adds the hook or breve
dd → đ
double d
s ´ · f ` · r ̉ · x ~ · j ̣
tone keys at the end of the word · z removes it

Try: banj → bạn · xin chaof → xin chào · nguwowif → người · camr own → cảm ơn. For English words press the tone key twice: taxxi → taxi.

The six tones

ma · ngang
flat, middle pitch
má · sắc
high, rising
mà · huyền
low, falling gently
mả · hỏi
low dip, then a small rise
mã · ngã
rising, with a break
mạ · nặng
low, short, cut off
